ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food web diagram shows a wild cat labeled “Wild cat.” Arrows point toward the wild cat from animals such as the rabbit and mouse. The rabbit and mouse are shown connected back to the green plant, indicating they eat plants. Reasoning: The green plant is the producer. The rabbit and mouse eat the green plant, so they are primary consumers. Since the wild cat eats these primary consumers, the wild cat functions as a secondary consumer.
